node.title: WCL ell=2 weight-7 quadruple-cubic prime-filter router
node.statement: Every official WCL (2,7) relation routes through a selected quadruple and complementary cubic. Two exact doubling recurrences characterize the cubic's order-1024 roots. Rational Norm(u) saturation is repaired embedding-by-embedding: shared primes are retained and tested by H_p=gcd(Phi_1024,F,G), with the u-zero factors removed before reconstruction. Exact Burnside enumeration gives 94,652,815 candidate orbits, making the complete census a recorded no-go. No candidate or official prime is excluded.
